# Burlington VT Taxi Ride

> Professional 24/7 taxi, airport transfer, long-distance, corporate, and ski-resort car service based in Burlington, Vermont. Fixed rates across Vermont, New England, and into Canada.

Burlington VT Taxi Ride serves Burlington International Airport (BTV), Montreal-Trudeau (YUL), Boston Logan (BOS), Albany (ALB), JFK, LGA, EWR, and 100+ Vermont towns including Stowe, Montpelier, Middlebury, Killington, Jay Peak, Sugarbush, and Smugglers' Notch.
